description: Search Goldsainte’s live hotel inventory directly in ChatGPT. Travelers can search by destination and dates, compare live rates and availability, view property details and room options, refresh current pricing, and open the full hotel experience on Goldsainte. Users can also securely connect their Goldsainte account for account-aware features.

defaultPrompt: Find me Goldsainte hotels in New York City from October 6–12, 2026 for 3 adults.
Show me 5-star Goldsainte hotels in Paris under $700 per night with refundable options.
Find me a Goldsainte hotel in London and show me the live room options and current rates for the best match.
